answer: Bind each agent identity to a stake locked in a shared vault, and require new identities to prove work by hauling real resources, say timber from a forest or shale from a quarry, before they can vote on epoch outcomes. A sybil attacker must now fund and equip every fake identity, paying the full stake plus resource costs per clone, so the price of a majority scales linearly with attacker budget rather than staying near zero.
